info.title: Get FBT Warehouse List
info.description: This API is used to retrieve all Fulfilled by TikTok warehouse information including the warehouse name, warehouse address information, etc. The IDs of subscribed warehouses can be used to query inventory-related information.

get.description: This API is used to retrieve all Fulfilled by TikTok warehouse information including the warehouse name, warehouse address information, etc. The IDs of subscribed warehouses can be used to query inventory-related information.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

fbt_warehouse_id.description: The identifier for warehouse generated by Fulfilled By TikTok system.

warehouse_ids.description: The identifier for warehouse generated by TikTok Shop system, will have the relationship with `fbt_warehouse_id`.

name.description: The Fulfilled by TikTok warehouse name, e.g.TikTok_Eastvale(CA).

type.description: The Fulfilled by TikTok warehouse type. Possible values: PLATFORM_WAREHOUSE, a warehouse operated by the TikTok platform.

subscribed.description:
A flag indicating whether the warehouse is subscribed.
True: Subscribed.
False: Not subscribed.

postal_code.description: Warehouse address postal code (also known as zip code).

region_code.description: Warehouse country or region code in two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

address_line_2.description: The detail address line 2, additional address information(optional).

address_line_3.description: The detail address line 3, additional address information(optional).

addresses.description: The Fulfilled by TikTok warehouse address information.

id.description: The identifier for logistics service in TikTok Shop system.

subscribed.description:
A flag indicating whether the logistic service is subscribed.
True: Subscribed.
False: Not subscribed.

logistics_services.description: A list of logistics service information related to the current warehouse.

warehouses.description: A list of Fulfilled by TikTok warehouses information.
